messages:
sophie: FYI Jakarta edge provisioning blocked — vendor says RMA batch delayed at customs, and our egress peering to GCP Jakarta is flapping. Need plan to keep Dedicated pool serving APAC.

maria: ETA on replacement units? do we have AWB/serials for the RMA? :thinking:

vendor_jt: Hi Sophie/Maria — RMA AWB: AWB123456789. Vendor lead time for replacements after customs clearance ~72h. We can split-ship 10 units from SG hub (est 48h). Pricing for expedited air is +$2,400 per unit if we push now.

sophie: thanks. Can ops route traffic to sg-edge to cover latency? What's the perf delta for latency-sensitive routes?

devops-ash: SG failover is ready but we need to patch routing policy to prefer SG for tenant:apac-lowlat. I'll push canary rule in 10m. BGP flap log attached:
```
Apr 12 10:12:21 bgpd: neighbor 203.0.113.5 reset (holdtime expired)
Apr 12 10:12:26 bgpd: neighbor 203.0.113.5 up
```

maria: ok do it. also can we avoid expensive air? prefer split-ship from SG and reuse loaners in JKT until RMA clears.

vendor_jt: we can split-ship, but customs release window may still add 24-36h. We'll prioritize the units with serials S/N: JKT-4001..JKT-4010.

liam: Ops note — console shows 12% Dedicated pool shortfall in apac-jkt. If we route, we should throttle batch sizes to keep latency SLOs. Recommend config:
`batch_max_tokens=128, max_concurrent_requests=6`

sophie: agree. Ash, can you add throttling rule and the canary? track token spend.

devops-ash: on it. Deploying rollout: `rollout create canary --route apac-jkt --to sg-edge --throttle` — will monitor for 15m. ops-bot will post any anomalies.

ops-bot: ALERT: apac-jkt-serving decreased available GPUs from 42 -> 30 (12% deficit) at 2025-04-12T10:15:00Z :warning:

sophie: thanks. vendor_jt please send invoice addendum for expedited option and confirm AWB tracking once cleared. Also drop photos for customs evidence to #vendors-ops.

vendor_jt: Will do. I'll ping once AWB hits customs release. ETA update ~36-72h depending on paperwork. :+1:

maria: documenting RTO: if shortage persists beyond 72h we trigger paid air uplift, approved by finance up to $30k. tagging @finance.

sophie: ok locking that. Anyone else?

liam: I'll update the per-route dashboard to show fallback latency and cost delta.

sophie: cool, thanks everyone. Closing loop once AWB moved.
